name: Sonic Riders: Tournament Edition
summary:
A modification of Sonic Riders known as Sonic Riders Tournament Edition or SRTE. This is a mod that "gears" the game towards competitive play. It was built on the belief that Sonic Riders was a misunderstood game, that it's in-depth mechanics and skill ceiling actually have competitive potential as an esport.

With balance changes, tweaked mechanics, helpful features, and additional content- the mod aims to create the definitive Sonic Riders experience!
